cycles.citizenshipRule: NZ citizenship OR a Permanent Resident visa is required at application. Foreign citizens who hold the stated permanent-resident visa are not excluded by citizenship alone; other foreign applicants do not meet this published condition.
cycles.residenceRule: Permanent Resident visa is an alternative to NZ citizenship. No separate applicant domicile rule is printed; verify right to work and agency process.
